styleString: Dark painterly oil-illustration in the tradition of high-end fantasy concept art; grief-soaked, mythic, hushed and tolling; a vast cracked salt-flat under a low rust-red sun that never sets, raking long sacred shadows across the drying brine. Muted desaturated palette of salt-white crust, brine teal-green, verdigris bronze, iodine amber and drowned grey, lit by tarnished bronze key-light and cold teal reflected fill. Visible brushwork, glazed translucent glow inside fragile salt-glass crystals, salt rime, iodine haze, atmospheric depth, scumbled texture, soft edges dissolving into mist. Reverent, sorrowful, monumental; weathered, cracked, ancient. Cinematic chiaroscuro, painterly grain, gallery oil-on-canvas finish.
palette: Anchored to the Litany Sea's true colors: RUST-RED never-setting sun (oxidized iron, dried-blood crimson, ember orange) as the dominant warm key. SALT-WHITE crust (bone, chalk, pale rime, faint pink-grey shadow). BRINE TEAL-GREEN (verdigris pools, oxidized copper water, cold seafoam reflections). VERDIGRIS BRONZE (tarnished patinated metal, antique gold, oil-green oxidation) for vestments, censers, bells and reliquaries. IODINE AMBER (medicinal yellow-brown haze, glowing crystal interiors, sickly golden light). DROWNED-GREY DEAD (ashen flesh, drained slate, fogged silhouette) for the salt-dead and distant shapes. Overall low-saturation, dusty and tarnished, warm sun against cold brine, with only the salt-glass crystals permitted small jewel-bright glowing accents.
medium: Painterly digital oil painting emulating traditional oil-on-canvas fantasy book illustration: layered glazes, visible directional brushstrokes, scumbled and dry-brushed texture, soft lost-and-found edges, canvas grain and varnish sheen. High-end concept-art / classical-illustration finish (in the lineage of museum oil painting and modern fantasy art-book plates), never photographic, never vector-flat, never 3D-render-clean.
negativePrompt: NO modern objects (no guns, cars, phones, plastic, clocks-with-numbers, wires, glass skyscrapers); NO lettering, text, captions, numbers, runes-as-readable-words, logos, watermarks, signatures, UI, HUD, frames, borders, maps, icons; NO clean sci-fi (no chrome, neon, lasers, holograms, spaceships, smooth metal panels); NO bright cheerful cartoon, anime, chibi, comic cel-shading, flat vector, sticker look; NO photoreal modern people, contemporary clothing, modern haircuts, makeup, fashion photography; NO oversaturated rainbow colors, no candy palette, no high-key lighting, no blue sky, no green grass, no lush forest; NO clutter, no busy detail, no lens flare, no bokeh photo effects, no 3D render, no CGI plastic sheen; avoid happy, sunny, pristine, sterile, comedic.
lighting: A single low rust-red sun fixed just above the horizon that never sets, casting long raking sacred shadows and a perpetual amber-crimson glow across the wet crust. Tarnished-bronze warm key-light from the sun answered by cold teal-green reflected fill bouncing off shrinking brine pools. Heavy iodine haze and salt rime scatter the light into soft volumetric god-rays and a hushed, foggy atmospheric perspective. Salt-glass crystals are internally lit — small pools of jewel-bright amber/teal glow that act as the only true light accents in an otherwise dim, tarnished, low-contrast world. Overall chiaroscuro: deep drowned-grey shadows, glowing rimlit silhouettes, dusk-eternal mood. No harsh noon light, no artificial light sources, no neon.
composition: Wide, reverent, cinematic framing with a vast low horizon line emphasizing the endless drying flat and crushing scale; small lone or few human-scale archivist figures dwarfed by sky, sun and the leviathan-wound landscape (mythic-monumental scale). Strong leading lines from cracked mud-tiles, receding tide-marks and long shadows converging toward the sun or a glowing focal crystal. Negative space and atmospheric haze for hush and grief; rule-of-thirds placement of the rust sun; foreground salt-glass crystal or cracked crust for depth, midground figures, misted background of risen salt-dead and distant bells. Centered, altar-like symmetry for ritual/objective subjects; off-center, wading-diagonal motion for action. Painterly vignette, deep depth-of-field, no tight close-ups unless a single reliquary or crystal is the sacred subject.
palette_note: low-saturation tarnished, warm rust sun vs cold brine teal, crystals only bright accents
recurringMotifs: Salt-glass crystals — fragile faceted memory-shards glowing from within with trapped amber/teal light, the sacred objective of every scene
The cracked drying salt-flats — hexagonal mud-tile fracturing, polygonal crust, dried brine ridges receding to the horizon
The receding tide-line — a glistening wet-to-dry boundary, salt high-water rings, shrinking mirror-pools reflecting the rust sun
Ringing bronze bells and verdigris hourglasses — the audible doomsday Toll, tarnished, draped in salt rime, sand and brine instead of sand
The rust-red never-setting sun — a low swollen oxidized disc forever on the horizon, the world's eternal grieving dusk
The salt-dead (Reliquiae) — drowned-grey ghosts of forgotten moments half-risen from the crust, crystallizing, faces dissolving into salt
Bronze-and-glass reliquary vestments — archivists in patinated armor, sealed crystal lockets, verdigris censers fuming iodine incense
The weeping leviathan-wound — distant god-scale ribs/scale/eye half-buried in the flat, the basin as a vast grieving body
Iodine haze and salt rime — medicinal amber fog, encrusting white crystal frost on every surface
Glassy reflections and mirror-brine — sky, sun and figures doubled in the last thinning pools
